<details>
<summary>Morning Unwoken — poem</summary>
	Morning Unwoken by Smart Chen
	light is what falls
	not what arrives
	through branches
	like an unfinished sentence
	the lake has no language
	but remembers
	the outline of distant dreams
	she emerges from the forest
	quiet
	unhurried
	like a breath not yet finished
	she looks toward nothing
	simply existing
	her gaze resting
	where light meets shadow
	before the wind begins
	the world is already altered by her presence
	she is no illusion
	nor a memory
	only the stillness
	that becomes visible for an instant
	the wind
	no answer
	only tying knots in the empty air
	language arrives before silence
	she is nothing but
	an unopened morning in your dream
</details>
